Class City

java.lang.Object
domain.City
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class City extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a City consisting of a name, map details, a center position, and a collection of house blocks.

  • Constructor Details

    • City

      public City(String name, String mapName, int centerX, int centerY)
      Constructs an instance of the City class, representing a city with a name, a map identifier, and its center coordinates on the map.
      Parameters:
      name - Name of the city.
      mapName - Identifier or name of the map associated with the city.
      centerX - X-coordinate of the city's center position on the map.
      centerY - Y-coordinate of the city's center position on the map.

    • addBlockManual

      public void addBlockManual(HouseBlock b)
      Adds a house block manually to the city's collection of blocks. This method allows for direct addition of a house block without any validation. Use with caution as it bypasses any automatic validation that might be present in other block addition methods.
      Parameters:
      b - The HouseBlock to be added to the city's collection

    • clearBlocks

      public void clearBlocks()
      Clears all house blocks from the city's collection of blocks. This method removes all HouseBlock objects stored in the list of house blocks associated with the city.
